def _normalize_ical_url(ical_url: str) -> str:
    normalized_ical_url = normalize_and_validate_ics_url(ical_url)
    if normalized_ical_url is None:
        raise CalendarUrlSubscriptionError(
            "Calendar URL must use a public http, https, or webcal address."
        )

def preview_ics_calendar_subscription(
    *,
    user: User,
    ical_url: str,
    account_name: str | None = None,
    timeout: int = 5,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized_ical_url = _normalize_ical_url(ical_url)
    source_host = _build_source_host(normalized_ical_url)
    metadata = _serialize_preview_metadata(
        fetch_ics_metadata(normalized_ical_url, timeout=timeout)
    )
    existing = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.filter(
        user=user,
        provider=ICS_PROVIDER,
        provider_uid=normalized_ical_url,
    ).first()

    resolved_account_name = _resolve_account_name(
        requested_name=account_name if existing is None else existing.account_name,
        metadata=metadata,
        source_host=source_host,
    )

    return {
        "ical_url": normalized_ical_url,
        "account_name": resolved_account_name,
        "source_host": source_host,
        "metadata": metadata,
        "already_connected": existing is not None,
        "calendar_id": str(existing.id) if existing is not None else None,
    }


def create_or_get_ics_calendar_subscription(
    *,
    user: User,
    ical_url: str,
    account_name: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> tuple[ExternalCalendarAccount, bool]:
    normalized_ical_url = _normalize_ical_url(ical_url)
    source_host = _build_source_host(normalized_ical_url)
    resolved_metadata = _serialize_preview_metadata(metadata)
    resolved_account_name = _resolve_account_name(
        requested_name=account_name,
        metadata=resolved_metadata,
        source_host=source_host,
    )

    defaults = {
        "account_name": resolved_account_name,
        "ical_url": normalized_ical_url,
        "is_active": True,
        "sync_enabled": True,
    }

    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            calendar, created = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get_or_create(
                user=user,
                provider=ICS_PROVIDER,
                provider_uid=normalized_ical_url,
                defaults=defaults,
            )
            CalendarVisibility.objects.get_or_create(calendar=calendar)
            calendar.associated_users.add(user)

            if created:
                _schedule_initial_sync(calendar.id)

            return calendar, created
    except IntegrityError:
        calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(
            user=user,
            provider=ICS_PROVIDER,
            provider_uid=normalized_ical_url,
        )
        CalendarVisibility.objects.get_or_create(calendar=calendar)
        calendar.associated_users.add(user)
        return calendar, False
